title: quest_markers
summary: The wire plane exists: CMSG_QUESTGIVER_STATUS_QUERY is sendable (QuestgiverStatus, range-gated through QuestGate), SMSG_QUESTGIVER_STATUS is parsed into a per-giver status map, and a status re-ask fires when a quest panel closes. But the module's actual player-visible product - the floating TalkToMe `!`/`?` markers over NPC heads - does not exist, and statuses are only ever asked for NPCs the player already interacted with.

openItems.text: No overhead markers are rendered at all: the status->model dispatch (grey/gold !/?, light-blue ?, attachment-18 seat, 1/L counter-scale, low/raised bob anims) has no counterpart - questgivers show nothing above their heads

No proactive status querying: visible UNIT_NPC_FLAG_QUESTGIVER creatures are never swept on create, and none of the re-ask law (self descriptor watch / packet-epoch sweep, per-unit flag/reaction re-ask, teardown when the questgiver bit drops) exists - status is only fetched on direct interaction or dev command
